prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create exactly one exceptionally crisp, flat, production-quality Korean design-system study board as a raster image, landscape 4:3, target 2000 by 1500. All measurements below are px-equivalent visual proportions, not printed measurement annotations.

FIXED CONDITIONS from the authoritative brief:
Use the prescribed B dimensions below. Do not print dimensions, numeric annotations, token names, grids or design-tool handles. Fixed studio-blue brand is #155EEF in light theme, the DDS dark-theme brand values below in dark theme. This is a comparison condition, not a brand exploration. Use exact DDS semantic colours below, never approximated substitute hex values. Korean-capable system sans serif only, regular 400 and bold 700 only: desktop body about 14px, supporting text about 13px, captions about 12px, titles about 20–24px; mobile body about 16px. Scale all these proportions consistently when presenting the examples on the board. Inputs focus with a 1px border plus 1px inner stroke, no outer focus halo. Non-input controls focus with a 2px ring and 2px offset. Floating panels have white surfaces in light theme or the exact dark surface in dark theme, a visible 1px subtle neutral border and overlay shadow. Basic lists and cards have no shadow. Icons are restrained single-stroke SVG-style line icons, never character symbols or emoji standing in for action icons. Small domain code badges and avatars are allowed only where they help understand values in this B board. Preserve the supplied Korean exactly with complete legible syllables, short formal copy, fictional data. No green primary actions, gradients, glass, 3D, perspective, device mockup frames, decorative charts, giant icons or card around every section. Mobile examples are unframed 390px-wide screen areas. At upper left place the small text "dg-design / flex study", then the board title and the exact subtitle "B · 원문 우선 재검토". Footer, small: "Design proposal · 2026".

EXACT DDS COLOUR TABLE, light / dark:
Default surface: #FFFFFF / #0F1212.
Weak neutral surface and hover: #F1F6F6 / #242727.
Stronger neutral hover: #E4E9E8 / #3A3E3E.
Main text: #242727 / #F1F6F6.
Supporting text: #6B706F / #AEB2B2.
Input border: #6B706F / #898D8D.
Subtle divider and floating-panel border: #E4E9E8 / #3A3E3E.
Disabled background and text: #E4E9E8 with #898D8D / #3A3E3E with #6B706F.
Solid brand and its hover: #155EEF and #175CD3 / #5298FF and #70A6FF.
Weak brand surface: #EFF4FF / #0B254A.
Brand text: #0D4AC4 / #84B9FF.
Text on solid brand: #FFFFFF / #0F1212.
Focus ring: #2B7FFF / #5298FF.
Critical text, solid fill, stroke, weak surface: #731115, #9B1C22, #C7272D, #FCF3F2 / #F0C9C5, #EF958E, #F04646, #4B090B.
Positive text and weak surface: #0F4A17 and #E7FCE7 / #83F289 and #06300B.
Overlay dim both themes: rgb(15 18 18 / 0.5).
Overlay shadow both themes: soft shadow equivalent to 0 12px 32px rgba(15,15,15,.18), with a closer 0 4px 8px rgba(15,15,15,.08) shadow.

VARIANT B DIMENSION PROPORTIONS ONLY — desktop / mobile, neither A nor current comparison columns:
Page horizontal insets about 32px / 20px.
Within-group field spacing about 10px / 14px; between-group spacing about 20px / 28px.
Work-panel body inset about 40px / 20px.
Input and select-trigger height about 40px / 56px.
Input corners nearly square about 4px / softly rounded about 14px.
Input inner padding about 12px / 16px; input value type about 14px / 16px.
Medium button corners about 6px / 12px; main CTA height about 48px / 52px.
Selection-panel corners about 14px in both; inset about 6px in both.
Option rows minimum height about 32px / 48px; row corners about 8px in both.
Multiselect square marks about 18px in both.
Menu panel corners about 12px and inset about 8px in both; menu rows minimum height about 32px / 48px; row corners about 8px in both.
Sheet inside corners about 16px in both; inset about 24px / 20px.
Two-line list rows about 56px / 64px high; one-line list rows about 48px / 56px high.
List row horizontal padding about 12px / 16px; leading-to-main spacing about 8px in both.
Chip height about 24px / 32px; chip corners about 6px in both.
Setting rows about 48px / 56px high with 14px corners in both.
Tabs minimum height about 36px in both, horizontal inset about 8px in both, gap to panel about 12px in both.
Table single-line rows about 44px in both.
Body type about 14px with 20px leading / 16px with 24px leading.
Common proportions: standard button heights 36px, 40px or 52px; checkbox about 16px with 4px corners or 20px with 6px corners; switch about 32 by 20px or 40 by 24px; floating boundaries 1px; confirmation dialog corners about 16px with 24px padding.

B CHARACTER:
"B · 원문 우선 재검토": Begin from usage. Preserve measured less-rounded desktop forms, input corners around 4px and buttons around 6px. Keep the existing DDS size when not measured, including Sheet corners around 16px and Tabs around 36px tall. Grouped forms use boxes, standalone inputs use lines, non-keyboard values use property rows. Field, button and chip Select triggers open the same selection panel. Settings are weak neutral surface rows with about 14px corners, about 48px desktop height and neutral selection dots; only the save CTA is branded. List is the first design grouping.

REFERENCE STYLE:
Match the inspected current DDS Storybook shapes and state treatment: thin crisp outline fields, small squared-round badges, restrained rectangular buttons, neutral option hover, compact check icon for selected option, subtle separators, bordered overlay panels and layered soft overlay shadows. Use Korean system sans serif as requested rather than the fallback serif seen in some raw captures. Do not copy the Storybook white canvas into dark-themed UI; dark examples use the actual dark surfaces above.

BOARD 11: title exactly "11 · 목록과 속성".
Light-theme white board. Build a calm, highly legible editorial component sheet with two large columns and a shallow lower band. No surrounding cards around section groups. Use section labels "List", "Chip", "PropertyField". Make individual example components generously readable, with consistent px-equivalent scale and generous white space.

Upper left: List, prominently first. A SectionHeader reading "콘텐츠" with small trailing count "3". Under it show two one-line list rows with small document line icon in the leading slot, main text "발행 일정" then "검토 요청", and separate trailing chevron row-opening control PLUS separate end three-dot menu button. The chevron and three-dot icons must be visually separate, with a narrow divider before the menu; opening a row and opening its end menu are different hit regions. Use 48px-equivalent single-line height. Then SectionHeader "담당자" with trailing count "2", followed by two 56px-equivalent two-line person rows: round initials avatars "김", "이"; main texts "김민지", "이준호"; secondary text under each "콘텐츠팀", "디자인팀"; trailing weak badge "담당" on the first, trailing chevron and separate three-dot menu on each. Indicate the leading, main and trailing slots with restrained small external English labels above the first row, exactly "leading", "main", "trailing"; keep these labels outside the interactive row. Neutral thin dividers, no row shadows. One subtle neutral hover row.

Upper right: Chip. Subsection "제거형": chips "김민지" and "콘텐츠팀", each with a distinct small stroke close icon. Subsection "필터 토글형": adjacent chips "전체", "검토 중", "발행됨"; "검토 중" selected with soft blue surface, blue text and small check, other two neutral. Subsection "필터 툴박스": a compact one-line toolbar with a small filter line icon, selected filter chips "담당자 김민지" and "상태 검토 중" with remove controls, plus clearly separated "결과 12개" and text action "초기화". Chips have 24px-equivalent height and 6px corners, visibly compact, not full-round pills. Below the toolbox show a very small result preview row "10월 브랜드 소식" to give context, not a chart.

Lower band: PropertyField, split into desktop on left and mobile on right. Subheading "데스크톱 인라인 속성". Three simple inline property rows about 48px high: "담당자" left, avatar plus "김민지" and chevron as the value; "발행일" left with "2026. 10. 12." and a calendar line icon; "상태" left with weak badge "검토 중" and chevron. Make labels and values horizontally aligned, with a short row width and no text-input outline. Subheading on right "모바일 속성 행". Show one narrow unframed 390px-equivalent white screen excerpt containing three 56px-equivalent full-width rows with labels left and values right: "담당자" / "김민지" with avatar and chevron, "발행일" / "10월 12일" with chevron, "상태" / "검토 중" with chevron. 20px-equivalent mobile content inset, generous touch row spacing. All value rows are visibly non-keyboard property selectors.

Do not omit: one-line and two-line List rows, leading/main/trailing anatomy, separate row-open and end-menu actions, SectionHeader, removable Chips, toggle filter Chips, toolbox result count and reset, desktop inline PropertyField and mobile PropertyField rows. All Korean must be spelled exactly and remain legible. No duplicate section names beyond those requested.
REVISION OF THE PROVIDED BOARD, keep its entire layout, titles, precise Korean spelling, components, counts and actions unchanged. Correct ONLY the avatar colour treatment and the subtle background noise: every initials avatar, including "김" and "이", must use a perfectly flat #F1F6F6 circle with #242727 glyph, no purple, no gradient, no illustration, no texture. White board pixels should be clean flat #FFFFFF. Maintain the exact subtitle "B · 원문 우선 재검토". Do not add new labels or remove any component. Render landscape 4:3.
notes: 원본과 보정본을 모두 저장하고 view_image로 검수했습니다.
원본의 보라색 및 그라데이션 아바타를 DDS 중성 아바타로 보정한 v2를 선택했습니다.
4:3 생성 결과는 1448×1086이며 목표 2000×1500보다 작습니다. 리사이즈나 이미지 후처리를 하지 않았습니다.
B 치수는 px-equivalent 시각 비례로 검수했으며 픽셀 단위 구현 정합성 검사는 아닙니다.
